q: What is the carbon footprint of the stretch film on a pallet?
title: Stretch film per pallet
short: Weigh the film on a typical wrapped pallet, then multiply by a factor for LLDPE film from your supplier or a named database. Pre-stretched film and better wrapping machines use less film per pallet, which is the easiest cut.

ol: Grams of film per pallet, weighed.
Times pallets wrapped in the year.
Times the film factor, labelled with its source.

p: Film you buy is Category 1. Film on pallets you ship to customers also ends up in their waste, Category 12.

example.title: Illustrative only
lines: Film: 250 g per pallet x 20,000 pallets = 5 t

senseible: Senseible reads the energy invoices behind the making stage into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, and keeps material invoices on the Scope 3 trail. Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
